text:
Sasha: Hey team — I'm starting on-call this week and hitting a couple of setup issues. Can someone confirm the pager rotation signup and where the runbooks are? Also mobile push isn't arriving for me.
Riley: Welcome! Quick answers: rotation signup is the Oncall spreadsheet (https://docs.google.com/.../oncall-rotation). Runbooks live in Confluence under Infra -> Oncall Runbooks: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall-runbooks. Did you get the PagerDuty invite?
Sasha: I did get the invite but I can't ack from mobile — it shows 'Offline'. Using iPhone 12. Also not sure which escalation policy to pick.
Sam: Try force-quitting the PD app and re-login, then check iOS push permissions. If that fails we can add you to SMS for the first few shifts. Escalation policy for most infra pages is `redwood-infra-main` (Dev Oncall -> SRE Lead).
Maria: For rotation signup, edit the sheet row with your GitHub email and timezone. I'll run the onboarding script to add you to the rotation once you add it. Ping me your timezone here.
Sasha: PST. Also where's the short 'what to do when pager rings' checklist? I remember a condensed flow: ack -> check runbook -> mitigation -> update incident.
Riley: Yup that's the short flow. Full details in the runbook. Quick snippet: ```When pager fires:\n1) Acknowledge in PagerDuty\n2) Check the corresponding runbook section for the alert\n3) Run triage commands in prod-monitor and gather logs\n4) If no resolution in 15 minutes, escalate to SRE lead and open an incident in #incidents\n5) Post an initial summary + mitigation steps to the incident thread```
oncall-bot: Reminder: New oncallers should shadow a senior for the first 2 rotations. Use `/shadow-request @sasha` to schedule.
Sam: I'll shadow you this week Sasha. When are you free for a quick run-through? 10–30m is usually enough for a walk-through of alert handling.
Sasha: I'm free 3–4pm PT today — that works for me. Also any tips for muting noisy alerts? Our service `embed-encoder` is spiking with false positives.
Maria: Open a ticket in ops-automation with a sample alert payload and we'll add an alert filter. For immediate relief you can lower that policy's severity to `warning` in PD so it doesn't page on non-actionable spikes.
Riley: Also useful test command if you want to simulate flow locally: `curl -X POST \"https://pd-api.internal/v1/incidents\" -H \"Authorization: Token token=TEST_TOKEN\" -d '{"incident":{"type":"incident","title":"test oncall trigger"}}'` — test token is in the runbook.
Sasha: Great, that unblocks most of my stuff. One last Q: who should I cc on postmortems? Product PM or just SRE + Eng owners?
Sam: Include PM + service owners + SRE. Keep the summary short (<1 page) and use the postmortem template in /docs/postmortem-template.
Sasha: :thumbsup: I'll run through the checklist and ping when I'm ready for the shadow. Thanks everyone!
